National Statistical Survey Report (Sample Data) Notice: This is synthetic sample test data generated strictly for developmental verification. Section 1: Executive Demographic Overview According to the survey enumeration, the total population recorded in the report was 1,380,004,385 across all surveyed administrative units. The percentage of rural population stands at 68.84%, reflecting continuous rural-urban demographic transition patterns. The overall national literacy rate recorded in the report was 74.04% for individuals aged seven years and above. The total number of registered workers identified during this survey period was 472,190,000 across organized and unorganized economic sectors. Section 2: State-wise Literacy Rate Analysis Table 2: State-wise Literacy Rates and Educational Metrics Educational attainment varied substantially across states. Kerala recorded the highest literacy rate at 94.00%, followed closely by Mizoram at 91.33% and Goa at 88.70%. In contrast, Bihar recorded the lowest literacy rate at 61.80%.
